title: Four short scenarios, 24 searches
lede: You will practice all six menu layouts once, then complete four blocks. Each block starts with a short scenario, a check-in, and six searches, one on each menu. We are testing the website, not you, so please say candidly what you notice.

cards.title: Think aloud
cards.text: Say what you are looking for and what you notice. The researcher may prompt you but will not help you find products.

cards.title: Search naturally
cards.text: Use the menu as you would in a real shop. Practice searches allow up to 45 seconds and scored searches allow up to 60 seconds. You can move on as soon as you find the watch, or choose to give up.

cards.title: Check in honestly
cards.text: After each scenario, rate how you feel. If distress is above 6/10, the session stops immediately.

cards.title: Stop anytime
cards.text: The visible Stop control is always available. You do not need to give a reason.

estimate: The study is designed to take about 20 minutes. You can continue through all activities if you need longer.
